title: USGS headline magnitude rounds up while API mag stays 4.96 (Petrolia, CA)
summary: On event nc75462637, the GeoJSON mag property is 4.96 but the published title string parses as M 5.0. Feed summary and per-event detail agree on the numeric mag; the cross-primary tension is human-facing title vs machine-readable magnitude on the same USGS planes.
